note: Fixes applied to the OpenStreetMap data by tools/build-track-graph.ts, checked against Gleisplanweb's track plan (gleisplanweb.eu, used as a reference only). Each says why; remove an entry once OSM has the fix, and the build will fail if it no longer applies.

links.why: Kungsträdgården: OSM tags the platform tracks as sidings from halfway along the platform, where they run on as the tail tracks. The stretch along the platform, to the first switch beyond it, is the running line.
